name: Omastat
author: rinesi
description: Local focused/open application usage for the Omarchy Quattro bar.

barWidget.description: Shows today's focused total, app breakdown, and 7-day usage patterns.

defaults.overviewCommand: bash -lc 'set -e; PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; out="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/omastat/overview.html"; mkdir -p "${out%/*}"; omastat export --lens day --output "$out"; xdg-open "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1 &'

schema.label: Overview command
